title: Book of the Watchers dated to around 300 BC

tellings.quote: The oldest section, namely the book of the Watchers containing this the the Enochian tale of the Watchers that was written at least cir circa 300 BC.

plain: The oldest part of the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish text left out of most Bibles, is a section called the Book of the Watchers, which tells of heavenly beings called the Watchers, and it was "written at least circa 300 BC," according to a guest named Tim Alberino. He gives this date himself on the show, citing the English translation of the Book of Enoch by R. H. Charles, published in 1917. The translation he names supports his framing in so far as it presents the Watchers tale as one of the book's sections; how firmly it pins that section to 300 BC or earlier is not quoted on the show, so his date stands as his reading of the scholarship.
